title: Plan simple GROUP BY column aggregate scan
problem: Simple GROUP BY column queries with SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/COUNT still materialized rows and used generic group expression evaluation even when only the grouping column and aggregate argument columns were required.
approach: Detect single-table GROUP BY one-column projections whose first projection is the group column and remaining projections are COUNT(*), SUM(column), AVG(column), MIN(column), or MAX(column).
Reject WHERE, JOIN, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, DISTINCT aggregates, and expression aggregate arguments.
Scan table rows and decode only the grouping column and aggregate argument columns.
Accumulate group aggregate states directly in a HashMap keyed by Value.
expected_impact: Improve Avg balance by type and Category avg price.
Reduce row materialization cost for simple GROUP BY analytics.
risk_controls: Keep GROUP BY expressions, HAVING, ORDER BY, WHERE, JOIN, and SUM(expression) on the generic path.
Add SQL integration coverage for aliases, NULL groups, mixed aggregate functions, and corrupt unused columns.
